stat.ML.authors: Víctor Soto-Larrosa, Nuria Torrado, Edmundo J. Huertas

stat.ML.authors: Minh-Phuc Truong, Khai Nguyen

stat.ML.authors: Chenghui Zheng, Garvesh Raskutti

stat.ML.authors: Xuelin Xie, Xiliang Lu

stat.ML.authors: Y-h. Taguchi, Yoh-ichi Mototake

stat.ML.authors: Yasin Abbasi-Yadkori, Peter L. Bartlett, Victor Gabillon, et al.

stat.ML.authors: Connie Trojan, Pavel Myshkov, Paul Fearnhead, et al.
stat.ML.summary: In online clustering problems, there is often a large amount of uncertainty over possible cluster assignments that cannot be resolved until more data are observed. This difficulty is compounded when clusters follow complex distributions, as is the case with text data. stat.ML.authors: Shahar Cohen, David M. Steinberg, Yael Radzyner, et al.

stat.ML.authors: Kang An, Chenhao Si, Shiqian Ma, et al.

stat.ML.authors: Satwik Bathula, Anand A. Joshi
stat.ML.summary: Multiplicative gating is widely used in neural architectures and has recently been applied to attention layers to improve performance and training stability in large language models. stat.ML.authors: Minhak Song, Liang Zhang, Bingcong Li, et al.

stat.ML.authors: Jiamei Wu, Ce Zhang, Zhipeng Cai, et al.
stat.ML.summary: Conformal prediction (CP) has attracted broad attention as a simple and flexible framework for uncertainty quantification through prediction sets. In this work, we study how to deploy CP under differential privacy (DP) in a statistically efficient manner. stat.ML.title: CLion: Efficient Cautious Lion Optimizer with Enhanced Generalization
stat.ML.authors: Feihu Huang, Guanyi Zhang, Songcan Chen
stat.ML.summary: Lion optimizer is a popular learning-based optimization algorithm in machine learning, which shows impressive performance in training many deep learning models. stat.ML.authors: Cheng Lu, Mengxin Wang, Dennis J. Zhang, et al.
stat.ML.summary: Data-driven operations management often relies on parameters estimated from costly human-generated labels. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and other AI systems offer inexpensive auxiliary data, but introduce a new challenge: AI outputs are not direct observations of the target outcomes, but could involve high-dimensional representations with complex and unknown relationships to human labels. stat.ML.title: Improving Machine Learning Performance with Synthetic Augmentation
stat.ML.authors: Mel Sohm, Charles Dezons, Sami Sellami, et al.
stat.ML.summary: Synthetic augmentation is increasingly used to mitigate data scarcity in financial machine learning, yet its statistical role remains poorly understood. stat.ML.authors: Ilsang Ohn, Shitao Fan, Jungbin Jun, et al.

stat.ML.authors: Dmitry Eremeev, Salem Said, Viacheslav Borovitskiy

stat.ML.authors: Horace Yiu, Leandro Sánchez-Betancourt, Álvaro Cartea, et al.

stat.ML.authors: Jackie Rao, Ferran Gonzalez Hernandez, Leon Gerard, et al.
stat.ML.summary: Antibody lead optimization is inherently a multi-objective challenge in drug discovery.
